content.title: Study Overview
content.description: This study focuses on preprocessing methylation data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) for Lung Adenocarcinoma (LUAD) and Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma (LUSC) to identify potential cancer biomarkers. The analysis leverages CpG and gene-level methylation profiles, processed using Python with pandas and numpy libraries.
content.context: Conducted as part of a 6th Semester Research Project titled 'Biomarker Cancer Identification and Prediction' at an academic institution.
content.objective: To prepare a combined dataset for downstream biomarker analysis by cleaning, transforming, and integrating TCGA methylation data.

content.title: Methylation Datasets
content.description: The study utilizes four methylation datasets from TCGA, processed on January 28, 2016, using the Illumina HumanMethylation450 BeadChip (Meth450) platform by Johns Hopkins University and USC.

datasets.name: TCGA-LUAD CpG Methylation
datasets.notes: Contains CpG site-specific methylation values for 459 LUAD samples.

datasets.name: TCGA-LUAD Gene Methylation
datasets.notes: Aggregated gene-level methylation data for 459 LUAD samples.

datasets.name: TCGA-LUSC CpG Methylation
datasets.notes: CpG site-specific methylation values for 371 LUSC samples.

datasets.name: TCGA-LUSC Gene Methylation
datasets.notes: Aggregated gene-level methylation data for 371 LUSC samples.

content.title: Preprocessing Workflow
content.description: The preprocessing pipeline prepares the methylation data for analysis by loading, transforming, and combining datasets.

subsections.title: Data Loading
steps: Imported Python libraries: pandas for data manipulation and numpy for numerical operations.
Loaded four CSV files into pandas DataFrames: df_methylation_1_cpg (LUAD CpG), df_methylation_2_gene (LUAD Gene), df_methylation_3_cpg (LUSC CpG), df_methylation_4_gene (LUSC Gene).
subsections.purpose: To initialize the datasets for subsequent processing.

subsections.title: Data Transformation
steps: Transposed gene-level methylation DataFrames (LUAD and LUSC) to reorient data with samples as rows and genes as columns.
Assigned binary labels: 0 for LUAD samples, 1 for LUSC samples, to enable classification tasks.
Resulting transformed shapes: LUAD (458 samples, 20115 genes), LUSC (371 samples, 20115 genes).
subsections.purpose: To standardize data format and label samples for machine learning analysis.

subsections.title: Data Combination
steps: Combined transformed LUAD and LUSC gene methylation DataFrames using pd.concat along the row axis.
Resulting combined DataFrame shape: (40230 rows, 829 columns), reflecting merged gene-level data with sample-specific columns.
Preserved attrib_name column to identify genes across samples.
subsections.purpose: To create a unified dataset for comparative analysis between LUAD and LUSC.

content.title: Key Observations
content.description: Insights derived from the preprocessing of TCGA methylation data.

points: LUAD datasets (CpG and Gene) include 459 samples, with CpG data spanning 40230 CpG sites and gene data covering 20115 genes.
LUSC datasets (CpG and Gene) include 371 samples, with similar CpG and gene coverage.
Combined dataset integrates 829 unique samples (458 LUAD + 371 LUSC), with some columns containing NaN values due to non-overlapping sample IDs between LUAD and LUSC.
Genes such as RBL2, VDAC3, ACTN1, ATP2A1, and SFRP1 exhibit distinct methylation profiles across LUAD and LUSC samples, suggesting potential biomarker candidates.
